name: Musician
summary: Proficiency with three Musical Instruments; a song after a rest gives allies Heroic Inspiration.

benefits.name: Instrument Training
benefits.summary: Gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments.
benefits.text: You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice.

benefits.name: Encouraging Song
benefits.summary: As you finish a Short or Long Rest, a song gives Heroic Inspiration to allies up to your Proficiency Bonus.
benefits.text: As you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can play a song on a Musical Instrument you are proficient with. Allies who hear it gain Heroic Inspiration; the number of allies you can affect this way equals your Proficiency Bonus.
